thread:
Alex: Quick proposal — let's try rotating facilitators for ARB over the next 6 weeks. 45m focused sync + 15m async buffer. Who can host Apr 5, Apr 12, Apr 19?

Mira: I can take Apr 5. +1 to 45/15. keeps the meeting tight. :thumbsup:

Jordan: I'll host Apr 12. small process ask: require a 1-paragraph pre-read for any RFC >2 pages and tag it [pre-read] in the agenda doc so folks can triage reading time.

Sam: I'll take Apr 19. I can also create a compact note template and a tiny host checklist so each week is consistent.

Alex: Draft agenda hosts should copy into their meeting doc (paste 48h prior). include expected outcome + required reviewers: 

Alex: ```
Expected outcome: <decision / feedback / next-steps>

Agenda (45m)
- 5m: metrics & blockers (owner, 2 bullets)
- 20m: RFC / design deep-dive (presenter + link) — mark [pre-read] if >2pp
- 10m: triage & compatibility checks
- 10m: decisions, owners, next steps

Async (15m): clarifying comments + update action items inline
```

Mira: can we add a single-line "required reviewers" field at the top? helps hosts nudge the right people.

Jordan: +1. also propose a simple rota spreadsheet with columns: week start, host, backup, notes. backups for PTO/swaps.

Sam: I'll spin up the rota + the note template now and drop the links here. I'll add a checkbox: "pre-read posted 48h prior" and a field for "presenter TL;DR".

calendar-bot: Reminder — ARB weekly slot Tue 10:00am PT reserved. To swap weeks, update the rota and tag @calendar-bot to update invites.

Alex: ops ask — hosts should ping required reviewers ~24h before the meeting if their review is blocking a decision. also paste presenter link + 1-line TL;DR at top 48h before.

Mira: noted. i'll post my Apr 5 RFC + pre-read by EOD Mon and add required reviewers.

Jordan: will publish Apr 12 TL;DR and reviewer list 48h prior.

Sam: rota link: https://docs.redwood.com/arb/rota — seeded Apr5: Mira, Apr12: Jordan, Apr19: Sam. backups column filled (Sam backup for Apr5, Alex backup for Apr12). notes template dropped in ARB folder.

Alex: i'll update the calendar invites and set a recurring host reminder 72h before their week. after two runs we'll iterate on the template.

Mira: tiny add-on — if an RFC needs data review, include a 'data owner' field so they get tagged directly.

Jordan: good call. let's add optional fields: required reviewers, data owner, decision type (approve/accept/refer).

Sam: updating template now. also adding a 1-line "decision rationale" field to force explicit reasoning for approvals.

Alex: nice. if anyone else wants to host in May, shout here. otherwise we'll roll with the rota and adjust as we go.
